implementationFacts.implementationPattern: Rule-driven directed graph: nodes carry domain data plus an immutable set of edge-generation rules; edges are formed via a two-way handshake (initiator + acceptor rule match) and recalculated on node insert, remove, or explicit updateNodeData() call
limitations: Beta status: breaking changes possible in any release before 1.0.0
O(rules * nodes) complexity per insertion/update; no built-in bulk-insert API
performanceCharacteristics: Direct data mutation avoids edge recalculation for performance-critical scenarios
transferSemantics: Directed, potentially one-way edges formed via independent per-direction handshakes
